This phone does not open the battery optimization screen.
Mic Monitor streams the audio from your phone microphone to a computer over the same Wi-Fi network. No program needs to be installed on the computer.

1. Connect the phone and the computer to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Tap Start in the app.
3. An access address appears on the screen.
4. Type that address in the browser on the computer.
5. On the page that opens, click Start to begin the stream.

Audio is only streamed after playback starts on the computer.

Only one computer can receive the audio at a time. When the streaming page is closed, another computer can connect.

The connection port is optional and can be set in settings. When left blank, the app uses the default setting.\n\nYou can set a different port if the default one is already used by another app or service. The change only alters the number shown at the end of the access address.

The buffer sets how much audio is stored before playback on the computer.

• Larger buffer: can reduce dropouts and glitches in playback, but increases the audio delay.
• Smaller buffer: reduces the delay, but can cause interruptions on unstable networks.
The speaker or headphones used to play the audio must be chosen directly in the audio settings of the computer.

Some phones may stop the stream when the app is in the background in order to save battery.\n\nIf that happens, turn off battery optimization in the Mic Monitor settings. This may increase battery use, but helps keep the stream running.
